title: Internal Hom commutes with integral coefficient inversion for general-lfp inputs
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be finite over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Put $B=p_X^*\underline R$ and $S=p_X^*\underline E$ on the small pro-étale site [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves and ambient relative derived tensor and internal Hom [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. For $M\in D(B)$ write $M_E=S\otimes_B^L M$. Let $K\in D(B)$ have bounded cohomology constructible in the general ring-object sense [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]: each cohomology sheaf admits a finite constructible locally closed stratification on whose strata it is pro-étale locally a cokernel $B^m\to B^n$ with arbitrary local matrix entries and finite $m,n$. Let $L\in D(B)$ have cohomology zero in sufficiently negative degrees; no constructibility or completeness is assumed for $L$.

The canonical evaluation-transpose map
$$S\otimes_B^L R\mathcal Hom_B(K,L)\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_S(K_E,L_E)$$
is an isomorphism, natural in both inputs. With the coefficient identification $S=B[1/\ell]$ and its repeated-$\ell$ module telescope [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x], its restriction to $D(B)$ agrees with
$$\varinjlim_n R\mathcal Hom_B(K,L)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_B(K,\varinjlim_n L),$$
where both sequential transitions are multiplication by $\ell$ and the colimits are exact termwise sheaf-module colimits of complex representatives [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. More precisely, on the $n$th telescope stage the pairing defining the comparison sends $(h,k)$ to $\ell^{-n}(1\otimes h(k))$. The assertion concerns this canonical map, independently of representatives, and the ordinary ambient derived category, without passing to a completed category.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.12 and Proposition 6.8.14(2), pp. 61–62, with the coefficient-specific general-lfp bridge. The internal-sheaf telescope comparison is an agent extraction; Lemma 6.8.12 itself is about global Hom and direct sums.
